title: The done sound
pick: Pick one take from any of the three. It becomes the whole family: Done is two hits with the second one higher, Fallback is one softer hit, finishing the day is a short rising run, and a reminder is two calm hits.

sources.label: iron_ting
sources.name: Iron rod on an iron bar

title: Skip, and something went wrong
pick: One knock for Skip today. Two quick knocks when something could not be saved.

title: Buttons and tabs
pick: The quietest sound in the app. It plays on main buttons and when you change tabs.

title: Switches and step ticks
pick: Turning a switch on or off, and ticking one step of a routine.

title: Undo, menus, next step
pick: Undo, the add menu opening, and moving to the next onboarding step. Played backwards for closing.

title: Saved
pick: A new routine, event, course or to-do is saved.

title: Fallback AI
pick: Starts listening (pitched up), stops listening (pitched down), and finished setting something up.
